extracted.intended_audience: general readers and students of Protestant religious history (Vaudois/Waldenses)
extracted.subtask_description: A chapter-length historical narrative recounting the persecution, massacres, exile, and military actions involving the Vaudois (Waldenses) in 17th-century Piedmont and surrounding regions. Focuses on events, personalities (e.g., Janavello, Henri Arnaud), and episodes such as the Bloody Easter, treaties, and the 1689 return expedition.
